connector.name: Countersign
connector.registryDescription: Kill switch + spend guard for AI agents that spend money, across every wallet vendor at once.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the countersign-network account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: COUNTERSIGN_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Countersign Core to govern (hosted or self-hosted).

env.name: COUNTERSIGN_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the Core (self-serve one at https://app.countersign.network/start or POST /signup).
